basic_info.description: Discover this inviting Edwardian flat in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Mission District with large exclusive garden outdoor space! This beautifully preserved home has classic period charm, offering a perfect retreat in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. The home features a master bedroom with ensuite bath as well as additional bedroom, separate living room and dining room. The kitchen is equipped with a high-end gas range, stainless steel appliances, and ample counter space to inspire your culinary creations. One of the true highlights of this home is the exclusive private garden, which features a mature lemon tree and a charming patio area, perfect for outdoor dining, gardening, or simply soaking in the San Francisco sunshine. In unit Washer / Dryer completes this wonderful home. Located 1 block from Dolores park and a short walk to the best part of the mission, including the famous bakeries, restaurants , cafes and bars of Valencia. Please note that some photos are virtually staged.
